body: When a strategy run proposes a change, the plan panel's heading reads `Change task title` as plain text (`solace_task.proposal_view`). Every other record reference on the page is a link that shows the record's title. The heading should link the same way. 1. **Link the record.** For an edit, `proposal_view` puts `record_link(kind, id, name)` in the heading after `Change `, the way it already does in its "Approving also sets…" lines, in place of the plain title. The link shows the record's current title. When the proposal renames it, the `title` field below already shows `old → new`. This is the same code for tasks, features and milestones, so all three get the link. 2. **Unchanged:** `Create title` (a new record has no id yet to link to) and `Replace the vision`. 3. **Tests** in `solace_task_test.gleam`: update `proposal_edit_and_vision_test` so an edit's heading contains the record's link with its loaded title, and a create's heading keeps the plain title. Run the components project's tests and any Strategy page test that checks the heading text.
title: proposals: heading links the record
